steps: Activate Fiendsmith Engraver (hand): Add 1 "Fiendsmith" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand
Activate Fiendsmith's Tract (hand): Add 1 LIGHT Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand
Activate Fiendsmith Engraver (GY): Special Summon this card
Activate Fiendsmith's Requiem (EMZ-L): Special Summon 1 "Fiendsmith" monster
Activate Fiendsmith's Sequence (EMZ-L): Fusion Summon 1 Fiend Fusion Monster
Activate Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron (M3): Special Summon 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation" from your Extra Deck
Nerva the Power Patron of Creation (Extra Deck)
Activate Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron (M2): Special Summon 1 "Junora the Power Patron of Tuning" from your Extra Deck
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning (Extra Deck)
Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron (Extra Deck)
Link Summon Purification Power Patron (Extra Deck)
select Junora the Power Patron of Tuning (M5)
Activate Theorealize Medius (hand): If a "Power Patron" card is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "Theorealize" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand
Activate Medius the Pure (GY): Shuffle 1 monster from your hand or face-up field into the Deck, and if you do, Special Summon this card
Link Summon Medicurius the Power Patron of Illusions (Extra Deck)
Activate Artmage Diactorus (M1): Change the battle position of 1 monster on the field
Activate Theorealize Past Lull (GY): Special Summon 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster from your GY
Activate Fiendsmith's Sequence (GY): Equip this card to 1 non-Link LIGHT Fiend you control
